title: 7 Best Herbal Creams For Menopause
intro: Herbal creams for Menopause are topical preparations made from natural herbs and plants, designed to provide relief from menopause symptoms such as hot flashes, night sweats, and vaginal dryness. The benefits of using herbal creams for menopause include reduced inflammation, improved skin health, and increased estrogen levels, which can alleviate symptoms and promote overall well-being. Examples of herbal creams used to treat menopause include Wild Yam cream, which contains diosgenin to mimic estrogen and reduce hot flashes, and Maca root cream, which contains sterols to balance hormones and improve mood. Additionally, creams containing Black cohosh, Red Clover, and Dong Quai are also used to treat menopause symptoms due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce hot flashes and night sweats.

preparations.preparation_desc: Lavandula angustifolia creams have been traditionally used to treat menopausal symptoms due to their calming and soothing properties, which help to alleviate hot flashes, anxiety, and sleep disturbances. The herbal preparation's ability to reduce inflammation and promote relaxation is attributed to its bioactive constituents, including linalool and linalyl acetate, which are known for their anxiolytic and antispasmodic effects. By reducing stress and promoting a restful night's sleep, Lavandula angustifolia creams can help to alleviate the emotional and physical symptoms associated with menopause, such as mood swings and night sweats. The benefits of using Lavandula angustifolia creams to treat menopausal symptoms include improved sleep quality, reduced anxiety and stress levels, and a overall sense of well-being.

Valeriana officinalis creams have been used traditionally to treat menopause-related symptoms, such as hot flashes and sleep disturbances, due to their calming and relaxing properties. This herbal preparation helps to treat menopause ailments by promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety through its sedative effects, which in turn can alleviate hot flashes and improve sleep quality. Valeriana officinalis creams contain bioactive constituents like valerenic acid, valeranone, and valepotriates, which contribute to their sedative and anxiolytic properties, helping to regulate the body's response to stress and hormonal changes during menopause. The benefits of using Valeriana officinalis creams to treat menopause ailments include improved sleep quality, reduced hot flashes, and enhanced overall well-being, making it a popular natural remedy for menopausal symptoms.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Electronic physician", Valeriana officinalis creams for menopause may be effective in treating menopausal symptoms, such as hot flashes, as part of the medicinal plants studied that showed efficacy in the treatment of acute menopausal syndrome.

preparations.preparation_desc: Vitex agnus-castus creams have been traditionally used to treat menopause-related symptoms, particularly hot flashes and mood swings, due to their ability to regulate hormonal imbalances and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, iridoids, and phenolic acids, in Vitex agnus-castus creams help to reduce stress and anxiety, thereby alleviating menopausal symptoms. By acting on the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis, Vitex agnus-castus creams help to regulate the production of estrogen and other hormones, leading to a reduction in hot flashes and night sweats. The benefits of using Vitex agnus-castus creams to treat menopause-related symptoms include improved sleep quality, reduced anxiety and depression, and a decrease in the frequency and severity of hot flashes.

preparations.preparation_desc: Cimicifuga racemosa creams, also known as black cohosh creams, have been used to treat menopause-related symptoms, particularly hot flashes and night sweats, due to their anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The herbal preparation helps to alleviate these symptoms by acting on the hypothalamus, the part of the brain that regulates body temperature, and by reducing the production of certain hormones that contribute to hot flashes. The bioactive constituents of black cohosh, including isoflavones, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, are responsible for its therapeutic effects, which include antioxidant, estrogenic, and anti-inflammatory activities. The benefits of using Cimicifuga racemosa creams to treat menopause-related symptoms include improved sleep quality, reduced frequency and severity of hot flashes, and enhanced overall quality of life.

Bioactive constituents such as gingerol and shogaol, present in Zingiber officinale creams, contribute to their therapeutic effects by modulating hormonal balance and relaxing the body. Regular use of Zingiber officinale creams has been shown to provide relief from menopause symptoms, promoting overall well-being and quality of life for women experiencing this natural transition.

The benefits of using Curcuma longa creams to treat menopause symptoms include reduced risk of hormone replacement therapy side effects, improved sleep quality, and enhanced mood stability.
